## Models

Two-way bindings: each model is an input and emits the matching change output.

| Model | Type | Default | Required | Change output | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `T \| null` | `null` |  | `valueChange` | Selected value in single mode. Ignored while `multiple` is set. |
| `values` | `readonly T[]` | `[]` |  | `valuesChange` | Selected values in `multiple` mode (controlled: write a new array to change the selection). |
| `open` | `boolean` | `false` |  | `openChange` |  |

## Outputs

| Output | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `opened` | `void` |  |
| `closed` | `void` |  |
| `selected` | `T` | Fires with the option value on every user selection (in `multiple` mode: every toggle). |
| `valueChangeCommitted` | `T` | Single mode: fires once per user selection that changed the value; never for programmatic writes. |
| `valuesChangeCommitted` | `readonly T[]` | Multiple mode: fires once per user toggle with the new array; never for programmatic writes. |
| `touched` | `void` | Fires when focus leaves the control (trigger blur with the popup closed, or a close that does not return focus to the trigger). |

### nameListbox

```ts
nameListbox(listbox: HTMLElement): void
```

Gives an unlabelled popup its accessible name from the trigger: the trigger's `aria-label`
or `aria-labelledby` when present, otherwise a reference to the trigger itself. A listbox
the consumer labelled (`aria-label` / `aria-labelledby`, static or bound) is left alone.
Attributes are read as they are when the popup opens, so `[attr.aria-label]` bindings work.

| Parameter | Type | Optional | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `listbox` | `HTMLElement` |  |  |
